text:
maria: Noticing repeated p99 tail jumps (~200-350ms) for low-qps chat tenants in eu-west when fractional rack slices evaporate quickly. Pattern: allocate -> kvcache regen -> cross-rack prefill -> queueing spike.

sam: Any NIC drops or retrans?

maria: mostly qdisc queueing, small retrans bump. ops-bot metric shows carveout_evap_rate=0.68.

kevin: Proposed mitigation: introduce local-warmup-window=60s for frac-rack allocations plus carveout-expiry bump 15s->45s. Safety: only localize if rack_free_gpu_frac > 0.15, else remote prefill with shaping.

lin: telemetry change: tag allocs with "alloc_ctx=frac_rack" and "warmup_path=local|remote". Also emit carveout_trigger_reason.

ops-bot: scheduled canary: 5% eu-west rollout at 03:30 UTC.

sam: canary command:
```
./allocctl --region eu-west --policy frac-rack --canary=5pct --local-warmup=60s --carveout-expiry=45s --safety-rack-util=0.8
```

kevin: Add kill-switch flag --disable-local-warmup. Success criteria: p99 tail down >=25% for small-chat, cost delta <6%.

maria: I'll run the canary and post graphs. tagging @oncall and @billing for visibility.
